'''To''' is an unclassified [[Mbum languages|Mbum language]] of northern [[Cameroon]] and the [[Central African Republic]]. It is only used as a [[second language]], as the secret male [[sacred language|initiation language]] of the [[Gbaya people|Gbaya]].
